'''Orrsa''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] bartender at the [[The Swirling Vortex|Swirling Vortex]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] aboard a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] near [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="University" />
